name: hnav_fusion
description: H-Nav read-time conflict detector with the FUSION screen: calibration-fit logistic over (CES score, ABTT-space cosine) replacing the parser same-key filter - the tail-complementarity result of experiment 5 turned into a screen
status: FAIL under the preregistered zero-harm rule (2026-08-27): calibration harmful suppressions plateau at ~305 across the whole tau grid (517/359/321/312/305 at tau 0/2/4/6/8, recall 0.93->0.87) - an irreducible high-ABTT-cosine cross-key core that NLI verifies even at 0.99. The frozen operating point is the vacuous zero-harm cell (recall 0, suppress 0); the arm is NOT run wet under this rule. Exploratory relaxed-harm analysis lives in stage0_results/geometry_filter/fusion_tradeoff* and is NOT a preregistered result.
preregistration: E2E-2 (2026-08-27): fusion form (logistic over max-z) chosen on CALIBRATION tails only; pair-level held-out tails dominate both components (hard tpr@1e-4 0.748 vs 0.598 CES / 0.468 ABTT-cos; transition-disjoint 0.536 vs 0.208 / 0.404). cos_pair frame fixed 0.80 (reuses the _ces prepasses); fusion tau (a logit) selected from {0, 2, 4, 6, 8} on sh_6k+sh_32k only; zero-harm selection rule unchanged. Parser still supplies relation identity inside the CES component - partial parser removal, same as hnav_ces.
